message.content: {"summary":"You delivered a solid preliminary SSO mission for GBR monitoring meeting all space segment sections with good STK evidence and trade justification. Strengths are clear mission rationale and complete orbit/ground design. Minor orbital mechanics slips and presentation/referencing weaknesses keep the overall mark in the lower Accomplished/Adequate bands.","criteria":{"C1":"You clearly stated the primary mission – coral reef/ocean monitoring using fluid lensing and AI – with bleaching rationale, justified a single spacecraft vs constellations, and identified CSIRO/BOM and government/university users. Well referenced in Introduction. To reach a higher Accomplished, add deeper literature depth on fluid lensing performance.","C2":"You justified Kourou ELV and Vega E with SSMS rideshare to SSO LEO, defined LEO SSO with a=6971km, e=0, i=97.79° and J2 precession, and provided Mount Pleasant ground station access plots showing 6-7 passes/day ~580s mean and drag-sail EOL. For next level, fix RAAN definition – it is not launch longitude and is set by LTAN for SSO – and ensure Argument of Latitude is described as time-varying.","C3":"Your Conclusion effectively summarises launch, orbit, ground station and EOL findings and links back to solving coral bleaching detection with ZYZZsat, noting Vega E risk and Vega C alternative. To strengthen to high Accomplished, explicitly tie conclusions to your STK results and maneuver evidence from the main body.","C4":"Your report has logical structure and an executive summary and is readable. To move to Accomplished, add consistent figure numbers/titles – e.g. Image 4 – avoid duplicated tables, and replace prohibited Wikipedia sources in your Bibliography with primary sources and apply consistent citation formatting."},"next_steps":["Correct RAAN concept in Orbit section: explain LTAN-driven RAAN selection for SSO rather than setting RAAN to Kourou longitude 27.33°, and show how LTAN maps to RAAN.","Improve report presentation: add numbered figure captions/titles for all STK screenshots, check for duplicated tables, and ensure every figure is referenced in text.","Fix referencing: remove Wikipedia entries, replace with peer-reviewed or agency sources, and ensure all in-text citations match a consistently formatted bibliography."]}
